designationHistory.name: Cedar Keys Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Herbert Hoover established the Cedar Keys Bird Refuge by Executive Order 5158; it is now Cedar Keys National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cedar Keys National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 5158—Establishing Cedar Keys Bird Refuge, Florida (Jul 16, 1929)

review.note: EO 5158, 1929-07-16 (Herbert Hoover). Draft signer field held "Presidential Executive Order"; President is Hoover.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cedar Keys National Wildlife Refuge was established on July 16, 1929, by Presidential Executive Order 5158, to protect a breeding ground for colonial nesting migratory birds.
